title: pawl.yaml
description: Configuration for pawl, a language-agnostic anti-regression quality gate. Editors use this schema for completion and inline validation while a pawl.yaml is written; `pawl validate` remains the authoritative check (see spec/commands/config.md).

^x-.description: Reserved for user extensions (YAML anchors, tool metadata). Keys with this prefix are never reported as unknown.

snapshot.description: Optional. Snapshot path, resolved relative to the config file's directory. Default: pawl.snapshot.json.

exclude.description: Optional top-level glob list shared by every filesystem-scanning dimension (file-length, file-bytes, pattern-count). Appended to that dimension's own exclude.

analyzers.description: Named analyzers: one acquisition shared by every dimension that references them.

id.description: Required. Unique across analyzers; dimensions reference it with source.

builtin.description: Required. Which acquisition contract to run: eslint, oxlint, sarif or lines. Acquired and decoded once per invocation, however many dimensions reference it.

timeout.description: Optional Go duration (e.g. "10m") applied to acquisition and verification; default "10m".

verify.description: Optional ESLint/Oxlint --print-config commands producing one config JSON per representative file. Every rule a referencing dimension selects must be enabled in at least one verified config, or the measurement fails. Valid only for the eslint and oxlint builtins (for the sarif builtin, use options.verify_rules instead).

options.description: Acquisition options for this analyzer's builtin; an unknown option is a config error, so the schema narrows it per builtin below.

dimensions.description: Every dimension pawl measures. At least one is required.

id.description: Required. Unique across dimensions; names the number in a verdict.

title.description: Required. Human-readable label shown next to the number in a verdict.

direction.description: Required. Which way is worse: lower-is-better for debt counts and size, higher-is-better for coverage and passing-test floors.

gate.description: Optional comparison mode; default total. total compares the single value, per-file-count refuses to let a fix in one file offset new findings in another, per-key-value protects each key already present in the baseline.

tolerance.description: Optional absolute slack in the worse direction, for noisy measurements; default 0.

timeout.description: Optional Go duration (e.g. "10m") for this dimension's command; default "10m".

artifact_max_age.description: Optional Go duration bounding the age of the report file a file-backed dimension reads (jscpd's report, a json-value/sarif/junit/coverage file, or a named analyzer's file). An older file is a measurement failure. Rejected on a dimension that reads no configured report file.

command.description: Shell command run under sh -c with the config directory as cwd, printing {value,unit,breakdown} JSON — unless extract is set, in which case it prints the tool's raw output. Exactly one of command, builtin, source.

valid_exit_codes.description: Optional complete set of exit codes that count as a successful run, for tools that report findings through a non-zero exit; default: only 0. Valid only on a command dimension.

builtin.description: Built-in adapter that does the measuring: a repo scan (file-length, file-bytes, pattern-count), a tool contract (eslint, oxlint, jscpd, swift-complexity), one number out of JSON (json-value), or a report format (sarif, junit, coverage). Exactly one of command, builtin, source; the lines builtin is an analyzer-only kind.

source.description: id of a configured analyzer whose decoded findings this dimension filters (rules/levels) without rerunning the tool. Exactly one of command, builtin, source.

options.description: Builtin-specific options, or selector options on a source dimension; the schema narrows this by builtin/source below. Options are read per builtin, so a key this schema does not list is not one pawl uses — and pawl ignores an unknown builtin option rather than failing, which is why this object stays open.

extract.description: Derive the measurement from the command's raw output instead of the {value,unit,breakdown} JSON contract. The scalar forms are the strings "number" and "lines"; the object forms name exactly one of regex / json_path, plus an optional unit. Command dimensions only.

oneOf.description: "number": the command's trimmed stdout must be exactly one finite number. "lines": value is the number of non-empty stdout lines.

includeGlobs.description: Required non-empty glob list of files to scan, matched against paths relative to the config file's directory; ** is supported.

excludeGlobs.description: Optional glob list of files and directories to prune; a matching directory is pruned without descending, and the .git directory is never traversed.

minFiles.description: Optional completeness floor: at least this many included regular files must be scanned after excludes apply, or the run is a measurement failure — never a recorded zero.

fileScanOptions.description: Options of the file-length / file-bytes repository scan.

threshold.description: Count a file as offending when it exceeds this size. Default: 500 lines for file-length, 32768 bytes for file-bytes.

patternCountOptions.description: Options of the pattern-count scan: every non-overlapping regexp match on every line counts.

pattern.description: Required Go regexp. Compiled at config load, so an invalid pattern aborts before anything runs.

eslintDimensionOptions.description: Options of the eslint builtin: pawl owns ESLint's JSON format and its exit contract (0 clean, 1 problems found, 2+ fatal).

command.description: Required. ESLint invocation producing --format json on stdout, e.g. npx eslint src --format json.

rules.description: Optional rule ids to count; empty or omitted counts every message.

verify.description: Optional ESLint --print-config commands; every selected rule must be enabled in at least one of them.

oxlintDimensionOptions.description: Options of the oxlint builtin: pawl owns Oxlint's native JSON format and its exit contract (0/1 accepted only with a complete native report).

command.description: Required. Oxlint invocation producing --format json on stdout.

rules.description: Optional native diagnostic codes to count, e.g. eslint(no-debugger) or unicorn(no-invalid-fetch-options).

verify.description: Optional Oxlint --print-config commands; every selected rule must be enabled in at least one of them.

jscpdOptions.description: Options of the jscpd builtin: duplicated lines (statistics.total.duplicatedLines) from the report the command writes. jscpd's own --threshold gating is not used, and a pre-existing report is deleted first.

command.description: Required. jscpd invocation with --reporters json, e.g. npx jscpd src --reporters json --output .pawl/jscpd.

report.description: Required. Path of the produced jscpd-report.json, relative to the config file's directory.

swiftComplexityOptions.description: Options of the swift-complexity builtin: pawl counts functions at or above threshold itself, so the command must not pass the tool's own --threshold (its exit 1 conflates findings with errors).

threshold.description: Required. A function counts as an offender when its selected metric is >= this value.

metric.description: Optional per-function metric to gate; default "cognitive".

jsonValueOptions.description: Options of the json-value builtin: one finite number at a dotted path, read from the command's stdout, from a file, or from a file the command produces.

path.description: Required. Dotted key path into the JSON, e.g. total.lines.pct.

command.description: JSON source: the command's stdout is the JSON. With file also set, the command produces that file first.

file.description: JSON source: a file relative to the config file's directory. With command also set, a pre-existing file is deleted before the command runs.

unit.description: Optional unit stored with the measurement, e.g. "%"; default "count".

sarifDimensionOptions.description: Options of the sarif builtin: results of a SARIF log, optionally filtered by ruleId and level. The command's exit code is not gated; the honesty guard is that a well-formed report with a runs array must be produced.

command.description: SARIF source: the command's stdout is the log. With file also set, the command produces that file first.

file.description: SARIF source: a log file relative to the config file's directory.

rules.description: Optional ruleId list to count; empty or omitted counts every result.

levels.description: Optional level list to count; a result without a level counts as warning, the SARIF default.

min_files.description: Optional completeness floor: the log must carry at least this many artifacts.

junitOptions.description: Options of the junit builtin: one quantity counted from the <testcase> elements of a JUnit XML report.

command.description: Report source: the command's stdout is the XML. With file also set, the command produces that file first.

file.description: Report source: an XML file relative to the config file's directory.

count.description: Optional quantity to count; default "failures". "passing" is tests - failures - skipped, for a passing-count floor.

coverageOptions.description: Options of the coverage builtin: a coverage percentage from an lcov or cobertura report.

file.description: Required. Coverage report relative to the config file's directory.

format.description: Required. Which report format the file is.

metric.description: Optional metric to gate; default "lines". "functions" is lcov-only, so functions + cobertura is a config error.

command.description: Optional. Runs the tests that produce the report; a pre-existing file is deleted first.

selectorOptions.description: Selector options on a dimension that uses source: which of the analyzer's decoded findings to count. The analyzer runs once however many dimensions reference it.

levels.description: Optional level list to count. For a sarif analyzer these are error/warning/note/none and for an oxlint analyzer error/warning/advice; a lines analyzer accepts whatever its regex captures.

eslintAnalyzerOptions.description: Acquisition options of an eslint analyzer.

command.description: Required. ESLint invocation producing --format json on stdout.

oxlintAnalyzerOptions.description: Acquisition options of an oxlint analyzer.

command.description: Required. Oxlint invocation producing --format json on stdout.

sarifAnalyzerOptions.description: Acquisition options of a sarif analyzer.

command.description: SARIF source: the command's stdout is the log. With file also set, the command produces that file first.

file.description: SARIF source: a log file relative to the config file's directory.

min_files.description: Optional completeness floor: the log must carry at least this many artifacts.

valid_exit_codes.description: Optional export of the producer's successful/finding exit codes; any other exit fails even when a parseable report was written. Requires command.

verify_rules.description: Optional. Every filtered rule id must appear in the report's tool.driver.rules catalog, so a misspelling cannot become a clean zero. Requires at least one referencing dimension with a rules selector, and fails if the producer omits the catalog.

linesAnalyzerOptions.description: Acquisition options of a lines analyzer: the tool-agnostic kind, which refuses min_files (line output names the files that had findings, not the files scanned) and verify/verify_rules (there is no rule catalog to verify against).

command.description: Required. The tool invocation whose line output is decoded.

regex.description: Required. Go regexp applied to every non-empty output line; an unmatched line is a measurement failure. Named groups path, line, rule and level are all optional.

valid_exit_codes.description: Optional complete set of exit codes that count as a successful run; default: only 0.

extractObject.description: Object form of extract: exactly one of regex / json_path, plus an optional unit.

regex.description: Go regexp applied to every non-empty stdout line; every line must match or the run is a measurement failure. A named group path builds a "<path>:<line>" breakdown from the optional line group.

json_path.description: Dotted key path into the command's JSON stdout, e.g. total.lines.pct. Must resolve to one finite number.

unit.description: Optional unit stored with the measurement; default "count".
